bullets.text: Fibre Rollout Hits 80% – UK’s full-fibre broadband coverage approaches 80%, driven by Openreach’s significant expansion efforts.
Full Fibre Adoption Surges – Despite a stagnant broadband market, full fibre connections in the UK have increased by 8%.
Online Safety Act Backlash – The UK’s Online Safety Act drives users to risky free VPNs, exposing data to foreign servers.
5G Connectivity Boost – Boldyn Networks and VMO2 enhance 5G at Sunderland's Stadium of Light, improving fan experiences.
BT Expands Cloud Partnership – BT Group signs a five-year deal with AWS to modernise its technology and enhance customer experience.
Disaggregated Networks Stalled – Telecoms face a paradox, with ambition for disaggregated networks clashing with execution challenges.
